findings: Same three credit-document categories as earlier framework, but current formalities must be used.
Direct-credit foreign authority confirmation is a copy under34(1)(b.1.3), not the original required by old62(3).
Sparing confirmation is original or certified copy under34(1)(b.2.3).
Indirect foreign authority confirmation is a copy under34(1)(b.3.4); representative authorisation is certified copy under34(1)(c).
Missing information/documents must be specifically explained in02/HTQT under34(2). Explanation does not establish substantive entitlement.
Proof accompanies annual finalisation, or tax return where finalisation is not required, under34(3). Do not transfer old10-working-day application handling statement to this procedure.

decision2551.scope: Corrects Article99(5) replacement form identifiers for business individuals; does not alter Article34. Effective on signing.

calculation_constraints: Form arithmetic is not standalone eligibility authority. Apply relevant treaty and Decree320 Article12(2).
Decree320 Article12(2)(c) contains a combined cap for paragraphb credit and allocated top-up credit; do not give each a separate full cap.
Top-up offset belongs to the declaration/payment period prescribed by Resolution107; do not automatically assign it to ordinary foreign income recognition period.
Do not gross up an already gross saved income amount a second time.
